evidence: DISPLAY_DEFORMATION(obj, angle, scale_x, scale_y) deforms every layer of the current animation frame of obj (src/affiche.c:1489). Every animation of the shipped game data has layers_per_frame & 0x3fff <= 20 and frames_count <= 200: PCMAP/ALLFIX.DAT, PCMAP/BRAY.DAT and PCMAP/RAY1..6.WLD parsed with the loaders' record format (load_world / LOAD_ALL_FIX / load_big_ray, src/load.c), every file consumed exactly. obj->animations points to such an anim_t table (12-byte entries: layers, frames, layers_per_frame, frames_count) whose layer table holds frames_count * layers_per_frame 4-byte layers; anim_frame < frames_count. The modelled object has 8 animations of up to 32 frames (anim_index 0..7, anim_frame 0..31) with layer tables sized for 32 frames x 20 layers, a 256-entry sprite table (sprite_index is a byte) and scale 0..256 (DO_MOTEUR2 domain).
